Rudier Foundry
The
Rudier Foundry
(
Fonderie Rudier
) was a
foundry
run by Alexis Rudier (died 1897) and his son Eugène Rudier (1875–1952). It worked with some of the most notable sculptors of the 19th and 20th centuries, including
Auguste Rodin
,
Antoine Bourdelle
,
Gustave Miklos
,
Aristide Maillol
and
Daumier
. Their casts were signed "Alexis RUDIER Fondeur PARIS".
